newsitem.title: CANADA: Denison CEO leaving to head Inmet.
newsitem.headline: Denison CEO leaving to head Inmet.

text.p: Denison Mines Ltd said on Wednesday that chief executive Bill James was leaving Denison to become chief executive and president of Inmet Mining Corp.
James said in a statement that "now that the capital restructuring is complete, and Denison is on a positive course in both oil and uranium, I feel my mandate is fulfilled."
Denison said it was forming a search committee to find a successor. In the interim, James will remain as Denison chief executive "to ensure an orderly transition of management."
